notes: The repair suite is judged by the engine, not by a text diff: tools/training/eval_repair.py
writes each returned macro to disk, runs it through the W1.8 harness (FreeCAD) and asks the
case verdict. A floor is the stock base model's measured rate on the same held-out prompts -
the same law as the chat suite (ADR-0015): a floor moves only as a reviewed event that quotes
the measured number, the model and the commit.
Measured 2026-10-20 on the frozen holdout (4 mutations) with the untouched base model,
4-bit, greedy, on a Kaggle T4: 3/4 repaired macros pass their own case and 3/4 cause no
collateral damage (0/4 are byte-identical to the known-good macro, so the stock model does
genuinely edit the code rather than replay it).
